finding.claim: The /rss endpoint opens a URL taken directly from the query parameter `u` and returns the first 400 bytes of the response. An attacker can make the server request internal hosts, such as cloud metadata at 169.254.169.254 or localhost services, and read the response. The response is partial, but it is not blind.

trace.note: params[:u] is passed unvalidated to URI.open, which fetches it with http/https/ftp
The first 400 bytes of the response are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No scheme, host or allowlist check and no private-IP blocking. TRUSTED is only used in /trusted. No authentication on the route. Redirects are followed by open-uri, though it blocks https-to-http downgrades.

verdict.reason: app.rb:8 passes unauthenticated params[:u] straight to URI.open(...).read with no scheme/host validation (the TRUSTED allowlist is only used at app.rb:14 in /trusted), and app.rb:9 returns the first 400 bytes to the caller.
